figurative_meaning_en: To conquer or win over the neighborhood; to become extremely popular or famous in one's local area
similar_in_english: Become the talk of the town
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার নতুন দোকানের জন্য সে পুরো পাড়া মাত করেছে।
এই খেলায় দলটি পাড়া মাত করল।
example_sentences_in_english: His new shop has conquered the entire neighborhood.
The team conquered the neighborhood with that game.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali communal life where local fame spreads quickly in neighborhoods.
